segments.text: We first tried Data analytics dashboard in 209. At the time, customer demand mattered because we needed visibility across branches.
The biggest issue was Cybersecurity concerns. Without steady power in Port Harcourt, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Data analytics dashboard—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 7 months.
Policy-wise, Regulatory licenses shaped our move. We adjusted by Peer learning.
Data helped; even a basic ML forecast gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
